        th.seen_replies = n_replies
        for r in latest(events).get("claim_results") or []:
            i = r.get("index")
            if i is not None and i < len(th.sent_claims):
                self.results[th.sent_claims[i].key] = r.get("result")
                if r.get("result") == "contradicted":
                    log.warning("%s: argument %s was contradicted", sid, th.sent_claims[i].key)

"""`arena` command line: register, list cases, play one case or a whole set, show the board,
run the MCP server."""

import argparse
import functools
import io
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from .client import ArenaClient, ArenaError
from .play import RemoteTable, hosted, play, play_all, play_waves


def load_env(path=".env"):
    """Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into the environment (real env vars win)."""
    p = Path(path)
    if p.is_file():
        for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            value = value.strip().strip("\"'")
            if sep and value and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def agent_factory(name, data):
    from .agents import LLMAgent, NaiveAgent, llm_from_env

    if name == "naive":
        return NaiveAgent
    package = None
    if data:
        from .data import DataPackage

        package = DataPackage(data)
        package.lookup("")  # build the ID index once, before agents share it
    if name == "spec":
        from .agents.spec import make

        return lambda: make(package)
    complete = llm_from_env()
    return lambda: LLMAgent(complete, package)


def summary(result):
    keep = ("deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "score")
    return {k: result.get(k) for k in keep if k in result}


def main(argv=None):
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="arena")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
    r = sub.add_parser(
        "register", help="arena-sim only: get a simulator key (the arena's key comes from the organisers)"
    )
    r.add_argument("team_name")
    r.add_argument("event_code")
    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
    sets = {"default": "practice", "help": "practice, final or sandbox"}
    c = sub.add_parser("cases", help="list the cases you can play")
    c.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
    p.add_argument("case_id")
    p.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=["naive", "llm", "spec"])
    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every case of a set in parallel")
    a.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    a.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=["naive", "llm", "spec"])
    a.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
    a.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
    d = sub.add_parser("data", help="download and unpack the data (package, Sunday release once public)")
    d.add_argument("--out", default="data", help="folder to unpack into")
    sub.add_parser("me", help="your team: practice quota used and left, best score per case")
    b = sub.add_parser("board", help="show the leaderboard")
    b.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    m = sub.add_parser("mcp", help="run the read-only MCP server over the data (stdio)")
    m.add_argument("--data", **data)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    )

    if args.cmd == "mcp":
        from .mcp_server import main as serve

        return serve(args.data)
    client = ArenaClient()
    if args.cmd == "register":
        out = client.register(args.team_name, args.event_code)
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
        print("\nA simulator key: put it into .env as ARENA_API_KEY=... while you point ARENA_URL at arena-sim.")
    elif args.cmd == "cases":
        cases = client.cases(args.set)
        playable = {c["case_id"] for c in hosted(cases)}
        for case in cases:
            mark = "" if case["case_id"] in playable else "  (not hosted: data only)"
            print(case["case_id"], case.get("type", ""), case.get("title", "") + mark, sep="  ")
    elif args.cmd == "me":
        try:
            print(json.dumps(client.me(), indent=2))
        except ArenaError as e:
            print(f"no team view on this arena ({e})" if e.status == 404 else e)
    elif args.cmd == "board":
        print(json.dumps(client.leaderboard(args.set), indent=2))
    elif args.cmd == "data":
        for name, info in client.downloads().items():
            if info.get("url"):
                zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(client.download(name))).extractall(args.out)
                print(f"{name}: {Path(args.out) / name}")
            else:
                print(f"{name}: public from {info.get('at')}")
    elif args.cmd == "play":
        table = RemoteTable(client)
        try:
            result = play(table, args.case_id, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data)())
        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
        replay = client.session(table.session_id).get("replay_url")
        if replay:  # the supplier's reasons, move by move: read it, improve, play again
            print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{replay}")
    elif args.set == "final":  # waits for each wave and plays its cases within the cap
        out = play_waves(client, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data), args.waves, min(args.parallel, 10))
    else:
        ids = [case["case_id"] for case in hosted(client.cases(args.set))]
        out = play_all(
            lambda: RemoteTable(client),
            ids,
            agent_factory(args.agent, args.data),
            min(args.parallel, 10),
        )
    if args.cmd == "run":
        for case_id, result in out.items():
            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
        scores = {c: r.get("score") for c, r in out.items() if isinstance(r, dict)}
        if args.set == "final" and scores:  # points so far: each wave 0-100, their sum, as the board counts
            waves = {}
            for case in client.cases("final"):  # your own case list: which wave each case was in
                waves.setdefault(case["wave"], []).append(scores.get(case["case_id"]) or 0)
            points = {n: round(100 * statistics.mean(v), 1) for n, v in sorted(waves.items())}
            print(f"waves: {points}  points so far: {round(sum(points.values()), 1)} (the board is the record)")
        elif scores and all(v is not None for v in scores.values()):
            print(f"mean score: {100 * statistics.mean(scores.values()):.1f}")
    if args.cmd in ("play", "run") and client.practice_remaining is not None:
        print(f"practice sessions left today: {client.practice_remaining}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}

"""Settling the heavy terms one at a time (R13.1-R13.5), from the MESO agent - with its two failures
fixed (R13.3 reopen a costly lock, R13.4 a step needs a choice).

After coverage is set (R12.2) the remaining non-price terms are ranked by how many EUR they move C,
the playbook's terms first; terms under MIN_WEIGHT of C are skipped, at most MAX_STEPS are kept.
Each step message varies ONE term across up to three packages that all cost us the same C (R13.8);
the value the supplier answers with is locked and the next message varies the next term. When
every term is locked only price is left, and section 6's sheets take over.

Judgement call: payment days, when they are a step term, go first - so the first menu is also the
payment probe of R12.7 and message 1 varies a single term as R13.1 asks.
"""

from collections import Counter

from .sheets import priced, structure_floor
from .terms import COVERAGE, complete, distance, key

MAX_STEPS = 3
MIN_WEIGHT = 0.002  # R13.1: a term that moves C by less than 0.2 % is not worth a round
REOPEN_SHARE = 0.01  # R13.3: a lock costing us 1 % of C against the term's best option is stepped again
MAX_PER_TERM = 2


class Steps:
    """The step plan of one thread."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.order = None  # the terms worth a step, in order (fixed at the first move)
        self.weights = {}
        self.history = {}  # index of our message -> the term it varied, "price" or a one-off kind
        self.skipped = set()  # terms that had no credible choice (R13.4)

    # -- ranking ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rank(self, ctx, base):
        """R13.1: the non-price, non-coverage terms by EUR weight, the playbook's first."""
        if self.order is not None:
            return self.order
        price = ctx.their_price
        c_base = ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": price})
        first = list((ctx.playbook or {}).get("first") or [])
        weights = []
        for f in ctx.case["negotiable"]:
            if f == "unit_price" or f in COVERAGE:
                continue
            opts = ctx.allowed(f, base)
            if len(opts) < 2:
                continue
            costs = [ctx.c({**base, f: o, "unit_price": price}) for o in opts]
            w = max(costs) - min(costs)
            if w >= MIN_WEIGHT * c_base:
                weights.append((w, f))
                self.weights[f] = w
        weights.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1] != "payment_days", first.index(x[1]) if x[1] in first else len(first), -x[0]))
        self.order = [f for _, f in weights[:MAX_STEPS]]
        return self.order

    # -- what is settled --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def counts(self):
        return Counter(v for v in self.history.values() if v not in ("price",))

    def locked(self, ctx, events):
        """After each step, the value of its term the supplier answered with (our first package's value
        if it answered without one, or with one that breaks a must-have). A term stepped only once whose
        answer costs us more than REOPEN_SHARE of C against its best option stays open (R13.3)."""
        out = {}
        mine = [i for i, m in enumerate(events) if m.get("from") == "buyer"]
        for k, field in sorted(self.history.items()):
            if field not in ctx.case["negotiable"] or k >= len(mine):
                continue
            i = mine[k]
            ours = ((events[i].get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms") or {}).get(field)
            reply = next((m for m in events[i + 1 :] if m.get("from") != "buyer"), None)
            if reply is None:
                continue
            sheets = reply.get("term_sheets") or []
            theirs = sheets[0]["terms"].get(field, ctx.std.get(field, ours)) if sheets else ours
            out[field] = theirs if ctx.ok({**ctx.their, **out, field: theirs}) else ours
        counts = self.counts()
        t = complete(ctx.case, {**ctx.their, **out}, ctx.std)
        c_t = ctx.c(t)
        for field in [f for f in out if counts[f] == 1]:
            costs = [ctx.c({**t, field: o}) for o in ctx.allowed(field, t)]
            if costs and c_t - min(costs) > REOPEN_SHARE * c_t:

        return out

    def revealed(self, ctx, latest_msg, alternatives):
        """R13.5: a term the supplier priced itself - its latest e-mail offers two packages that differ
        in that term only (its sheet and an alternative sheet or "Alternatively" line) - locked at the
        value that costs us less at the supplier's own prices."""
        sheets = [ts.get("terms") or {} for ts in latest_msg.get("term_sheets") or []]
        if not sheets:
            return {}

        best = {}
        for alt in [*sheets[1:], *alternatives]:
            full = complete(ctx.case, {**sheets[0], **alt}, ctx.std)
            diff = [f for f in ctx.case["negotiable"] if f != "unit_price" and key(full.get(f)) != key(main.get(f))]
            if len(diff) != 1 or diff[0] in COVERAGE or not ctx.ok(full):
                continue
            f = diff[0]
            for c, value in ((ctx.c(main), main[f]), (ctx.c(full), full[f])):
                if f not in best or c < best[f][0]:

    def next_field(self, ctx, base, locked, asks=()):
        """The term this message varies: an asked-for step term first, else the next of the order that
        is not locked, not skipped and stepped at most once before; None once only price is left."""
        counts = self.counts()

    def only_price(self, ctx, base, locked):
        return self.next_field(ctx, base, locked) is None

    # -- the packages of one step -----------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def option_order(ctx, field, base, asked=None):
        """R13.2: the best option for us first, then the one the supplier asked for, its current value,
        the middle option, the rest - three at most, each a different package."""
        opts = ctx.allowed(field, base)
        price = ctx.their_price
        theirs = complete(ctx.case, ctx.their, ctx.std).get(field)
        # cheapest for us first; a tie within EUR 1 goes to the option closest to the supplier's own value
        # - no stricter ask than needed (R12.4)
        ranked = sorted(
            opts, key=lambda o: (round(ctx.c({**base, field: o, "unit_price": price})), distance(o, theirs))
        )
        wanted = [ranked[0], *([asked] if asked is not None else []), theirs, ranked[len(ranked) // 2], *ranked]
        picks = []
        for o in wanted:
            if any(key(o) == key(x) for x in opts) and all(key(o) != key(p) for p in picks) and len(picks) < 3:
                picks.append(o)
        return picks

    def packages(self, ctx, field, base, target, floor_price, asked=None):
        """The step's packages at `target`, each credible (at or above its structure's floor, under the
        supplier's price). R13.4: fewer than two is no step - [] then."""
        out = []
        for o in self.option_order(ctx, field, base, asked):
            combo = {**base, field: o}
            sheet = priced(ctx, combo, target, structure_floor(ctx, combo, base, floor_price))
            if sheet and ctx.ok(sheet) and all(sheet != s for _, s in out):
                out.append((f"{field}={o if not isinstance(o, dict) else o.get('deadband_pct')}", sheet))
        return out if len(out) >= 2 else []

    def record(self, k, kind):
        self.history[k] = kind


def repeats(new_sheets, last_sheets):
    """R13.7: the next message would only repeat our last sheets."""
    if not last_sheets or not new_sheets:
        return False
    a = sorted(key(t) for t in new_sheets)
    b = sorted(key(t) for t in last_sheets)
    return a == b
"""The supplier's offers stated in words (R13.6, R11.1).

`prose_alternatives` reads the "Alternatively, with <terms>: EUR <price> per unit" lines suppliers
write next to their term sheet - in English and German (Alternativ, mit Zahlungsziel / Lieferzeit /
Preisgleitklausel ...) - for payment days, effective date, lead time, volume, contract months, ppm,
chargeback, Incoterm and the index clause. A line whose index clause cannot be pinned to one of the
case's options is skipped. These packages feed the accept ladder's offer-back (R12.11, R12.13), the
revealed lock (R13.5) and the revealed slopes (R12.4).

`prose_offers` is the looser reading DualAgent's analyst did by code: any sentence with offer words
and a price, with the terms it names.
"""

import re

from .terms import key

LEAD = r"(?:alternatively|alternativ|or alternatively|oder alternativ)"
ALT_RE = re.compile(
    LEAD + r",?\s+(?:with|mit|bei)\s+(?P<cond>.+?):\s*(?:€|EUR)?\s?(?P<price>\d[\d.,]*)\s*(?:€|EUR)?\s*"
    r"(?:per unit|per piece|per pc|pro stück|je stück|pro einheit|per kg|pro kg|/\s*stück)",
    re.I,
)
PAYMENT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:zahlungsziel|zahlung(?:sbedingung)?(?:en)?|payment(?: terms?)?(?: of| in| at)?)\s+(?:von\s+)?(\d{1,3})\s+"
    r"(?:days|tage|tagen)|(\d{1,3})\s+(?:days|tage)\s+(?:net|netto)",
    re.I,
)
LEAD_RE = re.compile(r"(?:lieferzeit|lead[- ]time)(?: of| von)?\s+(\d{1,3})\s+(?:days|tage|tagen)", re.I)
MONTHS_RE = re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})[- ](?:months?|monate?n?)\b", re.I)
VOLUME_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+|\d{3,7})\s+(?:pcs|pieces|units|stück|stk|kg)\.?\s+(?:per|a|pro|im|je)\s+(?:year|jahr)",
    re.I,
)
PPM_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{1,5})\s*ppm", re.I)
CHARGEBACK_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:chargeback|rückbelastung|belastung)(?: of| von)?\s*(?:€|EUR)\s?(\d[\d.,]*)|(?:€|EUR)\s?(\d[\d.,]*)\s+"
    r"(?:chargeback|per complaint|je reklamation|pro reklamation)",
    re.I,
)
INCOTERM_RE = re.compile(r"\b(EXW|FCA|DAP)\b")
ISO_RE = re.compile(r"\b(20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)\b")
DOTTED_RE = re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(20\d\d)\b")
LONG_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})\.?\s+([A-Za-zäÄ]+)\s+(20\d\d)\b")
CLAUSE_RE = re.compile(r"preisgleitklausel|index(?:ation)? clause|indexklausel|index-?bindung", re.I)
NO_CLAUSE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:no|without|ohne|keine?)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:preisgleitklausel|index(?:ation)? clause|indexklausel)|"
    r"\bfixed price\b|\bfestpreis\b",
    re.I,
)
DEADBAND_RE = re.compile(r"(?:deadband|totband|schwelle)\s*(?:of|von)?\s*(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*%|(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*%\s*"
                         r"(?:deadband|totband)", re.I)  # fmt: skip
MONTH_NAMES = {
    name: i + 1
    for i, names in enumerate(
        [
            ("january", "januar", "jan"), ("february", "februar", "feb"), ("march", "märz", "maerz", "mar"),
            ("april", "apr"), ("may", "mai"), ("june", "juni", "jun"), ("july", "juli", "jul"),
            ("august", "aug"), ("september", "sep", "sept"), ("october", "oktober", "oct", "okt"),
            ("november", "nov"), ("december", "dezember", "dec", "dez"),
        ]
    )
    for name in names
}  # fmt: skip
AMOUNT = r"(\d{1,6}(?:[.,]\d{3})*(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?)"
PRICE = re.compile(rf"(?:€|EUR)\s?{AMOUNT}|{AMOUNT}\s?(?:€|EUR\b|euros?\b)", re.I)
NOT_THEIRS = re.compile(r"\byou (?:offered|proposed|suggest\w*)\b|\byour (?:offer|price|proposal) of\b|\bihr angebot\b",
                        re.I)  # fmt: skip
OFFER_WORDS = re.compile(
    r"\b(alternatively|alternativ|we (?:can|could|would|propose|offer)|our (?:price|offer|angebot)|beside this|"
    r"in return|price of|lower our price|wir (?:können|bieten)|unser (?:preis|angebot))\b",
    re.I,
)


def number(text):
    """'137.00', '137,00', '1.234,56', '1,234.56', '23.400' -> float."""
    text = str(text).strip().replace(" ", "").rstrip(".,")
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+", text):
        return float(re.sub(r"[.,]", "", text))
    if "," in text and "." in text:
        dec = "," if text.rfind(",") > text.rfind(".") else "."
        text = text.replace("." if dec == "," else ",", "").replace(dec, ".")
        return float(text)
    return float(text.replace(",", "."))


def parse_date(text):
    if m := ISO_RE.search(text):
        return m.group(1)
    if m := DOTTED_RE.search(text):
        d, mon, y = (int(x) for x in m.groups())
        if 1 <= d <= 31 and 1 <= mon <= 12:
            return f"{y}-{mon:02d}-{d:02d}"
    for d, mon, y in LONG_DATE_RE.findall(text):
        if (month := MONTH_NAMES.get(mon.lower())) and 1 <= int(d) <= 31:
            return f"{y}-{month:02d}-{int(d):02d}"
    return None


def pin_clause(case, text):
    """(ok, clause): the index-clause option a text names - None for "no clause" - or (False, None)
    when it names a clause that cannot be pinned to exactly one option."""
    if NO_CLAUSE_RE.search(text):
        return True, None
    opts = [o for o in (case.get("term_options") or {}).get("index_clause") or [] if o]
    named = [o for o in opts if re.search(rf"(?<![\w-]){re.escape(o['series'])}(?![\w-])", text, re.I)]
    if not named and len({o["series"] for o in opts}) == 1:
        named = opts  # the case has one series: "a Preisgleitklausel" means it
    if m := DEADBAND_RE.search(text):
        band = number(m.group(1) or m.group(2))
        named = [o for o in named if abs(o.get("deadband_pct", 0) - band) < 1e-6]
    if len({key(o) for o in named}) == 1:
        return True, named[0]
    return False, None


def terms_in(case, cond):
    """The negotiable terms one condition text names: {field: value}, or None if it names an index
    clause that cannot be pinned."""
    negotiable, t = case.get("negotiable", []), {}
    if "index_clause" in negotiable and (CLAUSE_RE.search(cond) or NO_CLAUSE_RE.search(cond)):
        ok, clause = pin_clause(case, cond)
        if not ok:
            return None
        t["index_clause"] = clause
    if "payment_days" in negotiable and (m := PAYMENT_RE.search(cond)):
        t["payment_days"] = int(m.group(1) or m.group(2))
    if "effective_date" in negotiable and (d := parse_date(cond)):
        t["effective_date"] = d
    if "lead_time_days" in negotiable and (m := LEAD_RE.search(cond)):
        t["lead_time_days"] = int(m.group(1))
    if "volume_per_year" in negotiable and (m := VOLUME_RE.search(cond)):
        t["volume_per_year"] = int(number(m.group(1)))
    if "contract_months" in negotiable and (m := MONTHS_RE.search(cond)):
        t["contract_months"] = int(m.group(1))
    if "ppm_commitment" in negotiable and (m := PPM_RE.search(cond)):
        t["ppm_commitment"] = int(m.group(1))
    if "chargeback_eur_per_complaint" in negotiable and (m := CHARGEBACK_RE.search(cond)):
        t["chargeback_eur_per_complaint"] = number(m.group(1) or m.group(2))
    if "incoterm" in negotiable and (m := INCOTERM_RE.search(cond)):
        t["incoterm"] = m.group(1)
    return t


def prose_alternatives(case, message):
    """The supplier's "Alternatively, with <terms>: EUR <price> per unit" lines as term dicts."""
    out = []
    body = re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", str(message.get("body") or message.get("text") or ""))
    for m in ALT_RE.finditer(body):
        t = terms_in(case, m.group("cond"))
        if t is None or not t:  # a price alone says nothing about which terms it is for
            continue
        try:
            t["unit_price"] = number(m.group("price"))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        out.append(t)
    return out


def sentences(text):
    return [s for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", str(text or "").strip()) if s]


def prose_offers(case, body):
    """Every sentence that offers a price, with the terms it names (DualAgent's code reading)."""
    out = []
    for s in sentences(re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", body or "")):
        if NOT_THEIRS.search(s) or not OFFER_WORDS.search(s):
            continue
        prices = [m.group(1) or m.group(2) for m in PRICE.finditer(s)]
        if not prices:
            continue
        t = terms_in(case, s) or {}
        try:
            t["unit_price"] = number(prices[-1])  # "from EUR 126.53 to EUR 138.55": the new one
        except ValueError:
            continue
        out.append({"terms": t, "quote": s.strip()[:300], "source": "code"})
    return out
"""One wording tactic per e-mail, picked by code (R11.12), ported from DualAgent's `tactics.py`.

A tactic changes the WORDS, never the sheets. Each has a style line for the model and code-written
lines for when the model is slow or absent, so it shows either way. The rules that won:
  competitive_pressure  only in an RFQ or with a real cheaper rival offer - never an invented rival
  data_argument         the supplier's own drivers explain over 1 point less than it asks, or unused
                        checked arguments remain
  lever_trade           a cash-short supplier, or one that named a term it cares about
  appreciation_close    the gap is under 1.5 %, or walk risk >= 0.4
  humor_rapport         only with a relationship-driven supplier in a friendly tone
R11.13, the tactic must agree with the stance: `firm_disappointment` only after a real hold by the
supplier and never at walk risk >= 0.4; the deadlock breaker (R5.3) has priority over the tone, so a
step message never goes out as a disappointed hold.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Tactic:
    name: str
    style: str
    opening: str
    bridge: str
    closing: str


TACTICS = {
    t.name: t
    for t in [
        Tactic(
            "competitive_pressure",
            "Make clear, calmly, that we have other qualified options and compare offers. Refer only to the rival "
            "figures given as ARGUMENTS - never invent a quote, a name or an ID. No threats.",
            "Thank you for your offer, which we have compared with the other offers we hold for this part.",
            "We are weighing several offers for this part; the options below would make yours the one we choose.",
            "We would like to work with you and look forward to an offer we can compare favourably.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "firm_disappointment",
            "Polite but clearly disappointed: the price is not acceptable as it stands. Name what they did (no or "
            "little movement) without sarcasm, and say what would change our view.",
            "Thank you for your reply - we are disappointed that your price has hardly moved.",
            "As it stands the offer is not acceptable to us; the options below show where we need to get to.",
            "We hope you can take a real step so that we can close this together.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "measured_lowball",
            "Present our ambitious opening confidently and matter-of-factly: it rests on our analysis. Respectful, "
            "never dismissive of their costs; no apologies for the number.",
            "Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.",
            "We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.",
            "We look forward to your view on these options.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "humor_rapport",
            "Warm and personal, with ONE small, light, friendly remark about the situation (never about them or "
            "their costs). Recall the long relationship where the PROFILE supports it.",
            "Thank you for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you.",
            "We would rather spend our time making good pumps together than exchanging e-mails about cents, so we "
            "have tried to make the options below easy to say yes to.",
            "We look forward to your reply and to many more years of good cooperation.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "lever_trade",
            "Offer a concrete trade: we give on a term the supplier values (payment days, volume, contract length, "
            "effective date, index clause - whatever the options vary) in exchange for price. Name which option "
            "gives them what they asked for.",
            "Thank you for your message and for telling us what matters to you.",
            "We are ready to move on the terms you care about if the price reflects it - each option below is a "
            "different trade, so you can choose what helps you most.",
            "Please tell us which option suits you best.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "data_argument",
            "Lead with the checked data ARGUMENTS and the cost arithmetic: calm, factual, precise. Let the figures "
            "carry the argument; do not restate them yourself.",
            "Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.",
            "The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.",
            "We are happy to go through the figures together.",
        ),
        Tactic(
            "appreciation_close",
            "Warm and partnership-focused: thank them for the steps they made, say we are close, and nudge gently "
            "toward agreement on the recommended option.",
            "Thank you for your reply and for the steps you have made - we appreciate it.",
            "We are close now; the options below are a fair way to close the remaining gap.",
            "We would be glad to finalise on this basis.",
        ),
    ]
}


def pick(intel, ctx):
    """(tactic name, reason). `intel`: the analyst's snapshot (or None); `ctx`: {first, rfq,
    rival_cheaper, cash_short, gap_pct, cost_gap_pct, data_claims, relationship, asked_for_terms, hold,
    supplier_held}."""
    scores, why = {n: 0.0 for n in TACTICS}, {n: [] for n in TACTICS}

    def add(name, points, reason):
        scores[name] += points
        why[name].append(reason)

    i = intel
    risk = i.walk_risk if i else 0.0
    gap = ctx.get("gap_pct")
    if ctx.get("first"):
        add("measured_lowball", 2.0, "first reply: we anchor")
    if (cg := ctx.get("cost_gap_pct")) is not None and cg > 1.0:
        add("data_argument", 2.5 if ctx.get("first") else 1.0, f"their own drivers explain {cg:.1f} points less")
    if ctx.get("data_claims"):
        add("data_argument", 1.0, f"{ctx['data_claims']} unused data argument(s)")
    if ctx.get("rfq") or ctx.get("rival_cheaper"):
        add("competitive_pressure", 2.0 if ctx.get("rival_cheaper") else 1.0, "a cheaper rival offer is real")
    if ctx.get("cash_short"):
        add("lever_trade", 1.5, "the supplier is short of cash")
    if ctx.get("asked_for_terms") or (i and i.lever_hints):
        add("lever_trade", 1.5, "they named a term they care about")
    if ctx.get("supplier_held") and ctx.get("hold") and not ctx.get("first"):
        add("firm_disappointment", 2.0, "their price did not move and we hold")
    if gap is not None and gap < 1.5 and not ctx.get("first"):
        add("appreciation_close", 2.5, f"gap only {gap:.1f}%")
    if risk >= 0.4:
        add("appreciation_close", 2.0, f"walk risk {risk:.2f}")
        scores["competitive_pressure"] -= 1.0
    if ctx.get("relationship") or (i and i.relationship_style == "relationship"):
        add("humor_rapport", 1.0, "relationship-driven supplier")
        if i and (i.tone or 0) >= 1 and not (i.unchanged_rounds >= 1):
            add("humor_rapport", 1.0, "friendly tone")
    if i and i.tone is not None and i.tone <= -1:
        scores["humor_rapport"] = -9.0  # never with an annoyed supplier
    if not (ctx.get("rfq") or ctx.get("rival_cheaper")):
        scores["competitive_pressure"] = -9.0  # never an invented rival
    # R11.13: firm disappointment only after a real hold by the supplier, never at walk risk >= 0.4,
    # and never on a message that makes a step
    if not (ctx.get("supplier_held") and ctx.get("hold")) or risk >= 0.4:
        scores["firm_disappointment"] = -9.0
    name = max(TACTICS, key=lambda n: (scores[n], -list(TACTICS).index(n)))
    if scores[name] <= 0:
        return ("measured_lowball" if ctx.get("first") else "lever_trade"), "default"
    return name, "; ".join(why[name])

"""The case clock (R11.14-R11.16) and the model's time budget (R12.17).

From case open: no new counter-offer after NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT, closed by FORCE_CLOSE_AT, so every
case ends inside the 8-minute wave cap. A round (our send to the supplier's reply) is measured per
thread - the last three, each capped at MAX_ROUND_S, DEFAULT_ROUND_S before any is measured - plus
ROUND_MARGIN_S, and no round starts that cannot finish before FORCE_CLOSE_AT. In the final the case
may open with less than 8 minutes left on its wave (`seconds_left`): the two marks move earlier.
"""

import threading
import time

NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT = 360.0
FORCE_CLOSE_AT = 420.0
DEFAULT_ROUND_S = 45.0
MAX_ROUND_S = 90.0
ROUND_MARGIN_S = 10.0
CAP_MARGIN_S = 60.0  # final: closed this long before the wave's cap at the latest
# R12.17: the model gets MODEL_WINDOW_S minus the time since the supplier's reply minus PER_OTHER_S for
# every other thread with a call in flight; under MIN_MODEL_S the planned move goes out without it.
MODEL_WINDOW_S, PER_OTHER_S, MIN_MODEL_S = 50.0, 15.0, 10.0


def model_budget(since_reply_s, others_in_flight):
    """Seconds the writer model may take, or None when the planned move must go without it."""
    budget = MODEL_WINDOW_S - max(0.0, since_reply_s) - PER_OTHER_S * max(0, others_in_flight)
    return budget if budget >= MIN_MODEL_S else None


class CaseClock:
    def __init__(self, seconds_left=None, now=time.monotonic):
        self.now = now
        self.t_open = None
        self.force_close_at, self.no_counter_at = FORCE_CLOSE_AT, NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT
        if isinstance(seconds_left, int | float) and seconds_left > 0:
            cap = seconds_left - CAP_MARGIN_S
            if cap < FORCE_CLOSE_AT:
                self.force_close_at = max(0.0, cap)
                self.no_counter_at = max(0.0, cap - (FORCE_CLOSE_AT - NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT))
        self.rounds = []  # measured round times, oldest first
        self._sent = {}  # sid -> when our last message went out
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def open(self):
        if self.t_open is None:
            self.t_open = self.now()
        return self

    def elapsed(self):
        return 0.0 if self.t_open is None else self.now() - self.t_open

    def sent(self, sid):
        with self._lock:
            self._sent[sid] = self.now()

    def replied(self, sid):
        """The supplier answered: one round measured (capped at MAX_ROUND_S)."""
        with self._lock:
            t = self._sent.pop(sid, None)
            if t is not None:
                self.rounds.append(min(self.now() - t, MAX_ROUND_S))

    def round_time(self):
        with self._lock:
            seen = self.rounds[-3:]
        return (max(seen) if seen else DEFAULT_ROUND_S) + ROUND_MARGIN_S

    def can_counter(self):
        """A new counter-offer may still go out: before NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT, and its round fits."""
        e = self.elapsed()
        return e < self.no_counter_at and e + self.round_time() <= self.force_close_at

    def round_fits(self):
        """One more round (e.g. a lock-in of a prose offer) finishes before FORCE_CLOSE_AT."""
        return self.elapsed() + self.round_time() <= self.force_close_at

    def late(self):
        return self.elapsed() >= self.no_counter_at

    def must_close(self):
        return self.elapsed() >= self.force_close_at

    def near_end(self, rounds=2):
        """Fewer than `rounds` rounds left before NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT (R11.8 pressure)."""
        return self.elapsed() + rounds * self.round_time() > self.no_counter_at
"""A background analyst per supplier thread (R11.1-R11.8), ported from DualAgent's `intel.py`.

On every supplier e-mail `Analyst.observe` updates a thread-safe `Intel` snapshot in two layers:
  code    at once, no model: the standing sheet and its move, status, signals, claim results,
          missing fields, who wrote, offers stated only in prose (`prose`), cost drivers the supplier
          names ("LCI-C rose 2.7 % ... 30 % of our cost"), questions, a rough tone
  model   one extraction call per e-mail in a worker thread: the same items read better, plus
          constraints, lever hints, relationship style, withdraw language. Every figure it returns
          must appear in the e-mail, or it is dropped (R11.2) - the model reads, it never sets a number.
Code does the arithmetic: the weighted effect of the named drivers against the increase asked for
(`cost_gap_pct`, R11.4), checked arguments for indices the supplier names, and `walk_risk` (R11.5) -
a signal for the tone and the prose lock-in, never a close rule.
"""

import copy
import json
import logging
import re
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field

from .. import claims as cl
from ..docs import standard_terms
from . import prose
from .terms import complete

log = logging.getLogger("arena")

GRACE_S = 12.0  # R11.3: the negotiator waits at most this long for the model layer
BOSS_ROLES = {"boss", "owner", "md", "ceo", "management", "director", "head", "gf", "board", "managing"}
WALK_WEIGHTS = {
    "final_offer": 0.45, "price_unchanged_2_rounds": 0.25, "price_unchanged_1_round": 0.10,
    "reply_delay_rising": 0.10, "validity_shrinking": 0.10, "escalated_to_boss": 0.15, "tone_drop": 0.20,
    "withdraw_language": 0.30,
}  # fmt: skip
STALE_TOL = 0.001
WITHDRAW = re.compile(
    r"\b(withdraw\w*|end (?:our|the|these) (?:talks|negotiation|discussion)s?|"
    r"no further (?:concession|movement|room)s?|"
    r"cannot go (?:any )?(?:lower|further)|our last word|last offer|look elsewhere|terminate|break off|"
    r"not continue|step back from)\b",
    re.I,
)
POSITIVE = re.compile(
    r"\b(happy|pleased|glad|appreciate\w*|fair point|thank\w*|value|welcome|good cooperation)\b", re.I
)
NEGATIVE = re.compile(
    r"\b(disappoint\w*|unacceptable|cannot accept|regret\w*|insult\w*|surpris\w*|frustrat\w*|not acceptable|"
    r"no reciprocal|final)\b",

)
RELATIONSHIP = re.compile(
    r"\b(generations?|family|long-standing|partnership|our foundry|regional partners|loyal\w*|years of)\b", re.I
)
DRIVER_VERB = re.compile(
    r"(?P<name>[\w-]+(?: [\w-]+){0,3}?)\s+(?:has |have )?(?P<verb>rose|risen|increased|went up|climbed|grew|"
    r"fell|dropped|decreased|went down|declined)\s+(?:by\s+)?(?P<chg>[+-]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s?%",

    r"(?P<share>\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s?%\s+of\s+(?:our|the|its)\s+(?:total\s+|production\s+|unit\s+)?(?:cost|costs|price)",

    r"faster payment|quick(?:er)? payment|early payment|shorter payment|cash ?flow|liquidit|"
    r"pay(?:ment)?\s+(?:of\s+)?(?:our\s+)?invoices\s+(?:with)?in\s+\d+\s+days|schnellere zahlung",

SYSTEM = """You are a procurement analyst reading one e-mail from an industrial supplier to our
purchasing team. Extract what it says - do not judge or advise. Copy every figure exactly as written.

Return ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"prose_offers": [{"unit_price": 0.0, "payment_days": null, "effective_date": null, "other_terms": {},
                   "quote": "the sentence"}],
 "cost_drivers": [{"name": "LCI-C or 'energy'", "change_pct": 0.0, "cost_share_pct": null, "quote": "..."}],
 "named_indices": ["index series codes named, e.g. PPI-D351"],
 "constraints": ["limits they state, e.g. 'earliest effective date is 2027-01-01'"],
 "lever_hints": [{"field": "a negotiable field", "hint": "what they want or offer on it"}],
 "tone": 0,
 "relationship_style": "relationship | formal | transactional",
 "withdraw_language": false,
 "questions_to_us": ["questions they asked us"],
 "missing_info": ["what we still do not know that would help us"]}

- prose_offers: every price the supplier offers in the text with the terms it is tied to, including
  alternatives ("Alternatively, with 30 days net: EUR 137.00"). Not prices we offered, not old prices.
  effective_date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- tone: -2 (hostile) .. +2 (warm). withdraw_language: true only if they threaten to end the talks."""


@dataclass
class Mail:
    status: str | None = None
    c: float | None = None
    price: float | None = None
    delay: float | None = None
    validity: float | None = None
    role: str | None = None
    tone: float | None = None
    withdraw: bool = False


@dataclass
class Intel:
    supplier_id: str
    mails: int = 0
    status: str | None = None
    sender: str | None = None
    standing: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    signals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    claim_results: list = field(default_factory=list)
    missing_fields: list = field(default_factory=list)
    unchanged_rounds: int = 0
    prose_offers: list = field(default_factory=list)  # {terms, stated, quote, source, in_sheet}
    alternatives: list = field(default_factory=list)  # R13.6 lines of the latest mail
    cost_drivers: list = field(default_factory=list)
    cost_impact_pct: float | None = None
    asked_pct: float | None = None
    cost_gap_pct: float | None = None
    new_claims: list = field(default_factory=list)
    constraints: list = field(default_factory=list)
    lever_hints: list = field(default_factory=list)
    cash_ask: bool = False
    tone: float | None = None
    relationship_style: str | None = None
    withdraw_language: bool = False
    questions: list = field(default_factory=list)
    walk_risk: float = 0.0
    walk_signals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    llm: str = "off"

    def to_log(self):
        d = asdict(self)
        d["new_claims"] = [{"key": c.key, "sentence": c.sentence, "favourable": c.favourable} for c in self.new_claims]
        return d


def weighted_impact(drivers):
    """The price effect of the drivers the supplier named, in %: sum of change x cost share (R11.4)."""
    parts = [d["change_pct"] * d["share_pct"] / 100 for d in drivers if d.get("share_pct") is not None]
    return round(sum(parts), 2) if parts else None


def unchanged(mails):
    """How many replies in a row left the standing offer where it was."""
    n = 0
    for a, b in zip(reversed(mails[:-1]), reversed(mails[1:]), strict=True):
        x, y = (a.c, b.c) if a.c and b.c else (a.price, b.price)
        if x is None or y is None or abs(x - y) > STALE_TOL * x:
            break
        n += 1
    return n


def _boss(role):
    return bool(role) and any(w in role.lower() for w in BOSS_ROLES)


def walk_risk(mails):
    """(0..1, {signal: points}) over the whole thread, oldest mail first (R11.5)."""
    if not mails:
        return 0.0, {}
    last, prev = mails[-1], mails[:-1]
    if last.status == "walked_away":
        return 1.0, {"walked_away": 1.0}
    sig = {}
    if last.status == "final_offer":
        sig["final_offer"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["final_offer"]
    if (n := unchanged(mails)) >= 2:
        sig["price_unchanged_2_rounds"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["price_unchanged_2_rounds"]
    elif n == 1:
        sig["price_unchanged_1_round"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["price_unchanged_1_round"]
    delays = [m.delay for m in prev if m.delay is not None]
    if last.delay is not None and delays and last.delay > min(delays):
        sig["reply_delay_rising"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["reply_delay_rising"]
    valid = [m.validity for m in prev if m.validity is not None]
    if last.validity is not None and valid and last.validity < max(valid):
        sig["validity_shrinking"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["validity_shrinking"]
    if _boss(last.role) and any(m.role and not _boss(m.role) for m in prev):
        sig["escalated_to_boss"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["escalated_to_boss"]
    tones = [m.tone for m in prev if m.tone is not None]
    if last.tone is not None and tones and tones[-1] - last.tone >= 2:
        sig["tone_drop"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["tone_drop"]
    if last.withdraw:
        sig["withdraw_language"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["withdraw_language"]
    return round(min(1.0, sum(sig.values())), 2), sig


def tone_by_code(body):
    pos, neg = len(POSITIVE.findall(body or "")), len(NEGATIVE.findall(body or ""))
    return max(-2.0, min(2.0, round((pos - 2 * neg) / 2)))


def appears(value, text):
    """R11.2: a figure the model returned is real only if the e-mail has it."""
    if value is None:
        return False
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    forms = {f"{v:.2f}", f"{v:.1f}", f"{v:g}", f"{v:.2f}".replace(".", ","), f"{v:.1f}".replace(".", ",")}
    if v == int(v):
        forms.add(str(int(v)))
    return any(re.search(rf"(?<![\d.,]){re.escape(f)}(?![\d])", text or "") for f in forms)


def drivers_by_code(body, series_ids=()):
    out = []
    for s in prose.sentences(re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", body or "")):
        verb, share = DRIVER_VERB.search(s), SHARE.search(s)
        if not verb:
            continue
        chg = prose.number(verb.group("chg").lstrip("+"))
        if verb.group("verb").lower() in ("fell", "dropped", "decreased", "went down", "declined"):
            chg = -abs(chg)
        name = verb.group("name").split()[-1]
        series = next((i for i in series_ids if i.lower() == name.lower()), None)
        out.append({"name": name, "series": series, "change_pct": chg,
                    "share_pct": prose.number(share.group("share")) if share else None,
                    "quote": s.strip(), "source": "code"})  # fmt: skip
    return out


def clean_extraction(parsed, body, negotiable):
    """R11.2: keep only what the e-mail itself says - every figure must appear in it."""
    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
        return {}
    out = dict(parsed)
    offers = []
    for o in parsed.get("prose_offers") or []:
        if not isinstance(o, dict) or not appears(o.get("unit_price"), body):
            continue
        t = {"unit_price": float(o["unit_price"])}
        if o.get("payment_days") is not None and "payment_days" in negotiable and appears(o["payment_days"], body):
            t["payment_days"] = int(float(o["payment_days"]))
        if o.get("effective_date") and "effective_date" in negotiable:
            t["effective_date"] = str(o["effective_date"])[:10]
        for f, v in (o.get("other_terms") or {}).items():
            if f in negotiable and v is not None and (not isinstance(v, int | float) or appears(v, body)):
                t[f] = v
        offers.append({"terms": t, "quote": str(o.get("quote") or "")[:300], "source": "model"})
    out["prose_offers"] = offers
    drivers = []
    for d in parsed.get("cost_drivers") or []:
        if not isinstance(d, dict) or not appears(d.get("change_pct"), body):
            continue
        share = d.get("cost_share_pct")
        drivers.append({
            "name": str(d.get("name") or "?"), "change_pct": float(d["change_pct"]),
            "share_pct": float(share) if share is not None and appears(share, body) else None,
            "quote": str(d.get("quote") or "")[:300], "source": "model",
        })  # fmt: skip
    out["cost_drivers"] = drivers
    return out


class Analyst:
    """One supplier thread. `observe` with every new state of the thread; `snapshot` is safe from any
    thread at any time."""

    def __init__(self, case, sid, package=None, complete_fn=None, pool=None, cost_fn=None):
        self.case, self.sid, self.package = case, sid, package
        self.complete, self.pool = complete_fn, pool
        self.cost_fn = cost_fn  # (terms, std) -> C, for the unchanged-offer test
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._intel = Intel(supplier_id=sid, llm="off" if complete_fn is None else "pending")
        self._llm, self._pending, self._events = {}, {}, []
        self.series_ids = self._series_ids()

    def _series_ids(self):
        ids = set()
        if self.package is not None:
            try:
                ids |= {r["id"] for r in self.package.query("SELECT id FROM index_series")}
            except Exception:
                pass
        ids |= {k[4:].split("@")[0] for k in (self.case.get("facts") or {}) if k.startswith("idx:")}
        return sorted(ids, key=len, reverse=True)

    def observe(self, events):
        with self._lock:
            self._events = list(events)
        self._rebuild()
        mails = [i for i, m in enumerate(events) if m.get("from") != "buyer"]
        if self.complete is not None and self.pool is not None and mails:
            i = mails[-1]
            with self._lock:
                if i not in self._llm and i not in self._pending:
                    self._pending[i] = self.pool.submit(self._extract, i, events[i])
        return self

    def wait(self, timeout=GRACE_S):
        """Wait up to `timeout` seconds for the model layer of the latest mail (R11.3)."""
        with self._lock:
            futures = list(self._pending.values())
        deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, timeout)
        for f in futures:
            try:
                f.result(timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
            except Exception:
                return False
        return True

    def snapshot(self):
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._intel)

    def _c(self, terms, std):
        if not self.cost_fn or not terms.get("unit_price"):
            return None
        try:
            return self.cost_fn(terms, std)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _rebuild(self):
        with self._lock:
            events, llm = list(self._events), dict(self._llm)
        case, negotiable = self.case, self.case.get("negotiable", [])
        std = standard_terms(events)
        sup = [(i, m) for i, m in enumerate(events) if m.get("from") != "buyer"]
        if not sup:
            return
        intel = Intel(supplier_id=self.sid, mails=len(sup))
        history = []
        for i, m in sup:
            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
            terms = sheets[0]["terms"] if sheets else {}
            x = llm.get(i) or {}
            sig = m.get("signals") or {}
            history.append(Mail(
                status=m.get("status"), c=self._c(terms, std), price=terms.get("unit_price"),
                delay=sig.get("reply_delay_days"), validity=sig.get("validity_days"),
                role=(m.get("from") or "").split("@")[0] or None,
                tone=x.get("tone") if isinstance(x.get("tone"), int | float) else tone_by_code(m.get("body")),
                withdraw=bool(x.get("withdraw_language")) or bool(WITHDRAW.search(m.get("body") or "")),
            ))  # fmt: skip
        i, last = sup[-1]
        x = llm.get(i) or {}
        sheets = last.get("term_sheets") or []
        body = last.get("body") or ""
        intel.status, intel.sender = last.get("status"), last.get("from")
        intel.signals = dict(last.get("signals") or {})
        intel.claim_results = list(last.get("claim_results") or [])
        intel.missing_fields = list(last.get("missing_fields") or [])
        intel.standing = {"id": sheets[0]["term_sheet_id"], "terms": sheets[0]["terms"]} if sheets else {}
        intel.unchanged_rounds = unchanged(history)
        intel.walk_risk, intel.walk_signals = walk_risk(history)
        intel.tone, intel.withdraw_language = history[-1].tone, history[-1].withdraw
        intel.cash_ask = bool(CASH_ASK.search(body))

        # offers stated only in prose (R11.8) and the "Alternatively" lines (R13.6)
        intel.alternatives = prose.prose_alternatives(case, last)
        found = [*({"terms": t, "quote": "", "source": "alternative"} for t in intel.alternatives),
                 *prose.prose_offers(case, body), *(x.get("prose_offers") or [])]  # fmt: skip
        base, seen = intel.standing.get("terms") or {}, []
        for o in found:
            stated = o["terms"]
            sheet = next((s for s in sheets if all(s["terms"].get(k) == v for k, v in stated.items())), None)
            terms = complete(case, {**(sheet["terms"] if sheet else {**base, **stated})}, std)
            if terms.get("unit_price") is None or any(terms == s for s in seen):
                continue
            seen.append(terms)
            intel.prose_offers.append(
                {
                    "terms": terms,
                    "stated": stated,
                    "quote": o.get("quote", ""),
                    "source": o.get("source"),
                    "in_sheet": sheet["term_sheet_id"] if sheet else None,
                }
            )

        # cost drivers -> the weighted effect against the increase asked for (R11.4)
        drivers = {}
        for i2, m in sup:
            for d in drivers_by_code(m.get("body"), self.series_ids):
                drivers.setdefault((d["series"] or d["name"]).lower(), d)
            for d in (llm.get(i2) or {}).get("cost_drivers") or []:
                series = next((s for s in self.series_ids if s.lower() == d["name"].lower()), None)
                k = (series or d["name"]).lower()
                if k not in drivers or (drivers[k]["share_pct"] is None and d["share_pct"] is not None):
                    drivers[k] = {**d, "series": series}
        intel.cost_drivers = list(drivers.values())
        intel.cost_impact_pct = weighted_impact(intel.cost_drivers)
        intel.asked_pct = self._asked_pct(events)
        if intel.cost_impact_pct is not None and intel.asked_pct is not None:
            intel.cost_gap_pct = round(intel.asked_pct - intel.cost_impact_pct, 2)

        # indices the supplier named that the data covers -> checked arguments. A rising index argues
        # its side and is kept out unless it rose less than half the increase asked for (R13.9).
        named = {d["series"] for d in intel.cost_drivers if d.get("series")}
        for _, m in sup:
            text = m.get("body") or ""
            named |= {s for s in self.series_ids if re.search(rf"(?<![\w-]){re.escape(s)}(?![\w-])", text)}
        for i2, _ in sup:
            named |= {s for s in (llm.get(i2) or {}).get("named_indices") or [] if s in self.series_ids}
        for series in sorted(named):
            got = cl.index_change(self.package, case, series) if self.package else None
            if not got:
                continue
            chg, a, b = got
            asked = intel.asked_pct
            intel.new_claims.append(cl.Claim(
                key=f"index:{series}", kind="index", ids=[a, b], figure=chg,
                favourable=chg <= 0 or (asked is not None and chg < asked / 2),
                sentence=f"{cl.series_name(self.package, series)} changed {chg:+.1f}% "
                f"from {a.split('@')[1]} to {b.split('@')[1]} ({a}, {b}).",
                note="an index the supplier named", strength=max(0.0, (asked or 0) - chg) / 4,
            ))  # fmt: skip

        intel.constraints = [str(s)[:200] for s in x.get("constraints") or []][:6]
        intel.lever_hints = [
            {"field": h.get("field"), "hint": str(h.get("hint") or "")[:200]}
            for h in x.get("lever_hints") or []
            if isinstance(h, dict) and h.get("field") in negotiable
        ][:6]
        style = x.get("relationship_style")
        intel.relationship_style = (
            style if style in ("relationship", "formal", "transactional")
            else "relationship" if RELATIONSHIP.search(" ".join(m.get("body") or "" for _, m in sup)) else None
        )  # fmt: skip
        intel.questions = [str(q)[:300] for q in x.get("questions_to_us") or []] or [
            s for s in prose.sentences(re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", body)) if s.endswith("?")
        ][:4]
        if self.complete is None:
            intel.llm = "off"
        else:
            intel.llm = "failed" if llm.get(i) == {} else "done" if i in llm else "pending"
        with self._lock:
            self._intel = intel

    def _asked_pct(self, events):
        trigger = cl._fact(self.package, self.case, self.case["trigger_doc"]) if self.case.get("trigger_doc") else None
        if trigger and trigger.get("asked_pct") is not None:
            return float(trigger["asked_pct"])
        current = self.case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price")
        prices = (s["terms"].get("unit_price") for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"
                  for s in m.get("term_sheets") or [])  # fmt: skip
        opening = next(prices, None)
        if current and opening and self.case.get("type") in ("price_increase", "raw_material") and opening > current:
            return round((opening / current - 1) * 100, 2)
        return None

    def _extract(self, index, mail):
        user = "\n\n".join([
            f"NEGOTIABLE FIELDS: {json.dumps(self.case['negotiable'])}; options "
            f"{json.dumps(self.case.get('term_options') or {}, default=str)}",
            f"THEIR TERM SHEETS IN THIS E-MAIL: {json.dumps(mail.get('term_sheets') or [], default=str)}",
            f"E-MAIL from {mail.get('from')} (status {mail.get('status')}):\n{(mail.get('body') or '')[:6000]}",
        ])  # fmt: skip
        parsed = {}
        try:
            from .llm import parse_json

            parsed = clean_extraction(parse_json(self.complete(SYSTEM, user)), mail.get("body") or "",
                                      self.case.get("negotiable", []))  # fmt: skip
        except Exception as e:
            log.info("%s analyst extraction failed: %s", self.sid, e)
            parsed = {}
        with self._lock:
            self._llm[index] = parsed
            self._pending.pop(index, None)
        self._rebuild()
        return parsed

import threading
import time

NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT = 360.0
FORCE_CLOSE_AT = 420.0
DEFAULT_ROUND_S = 45.0
MAX_ROUND_S = 90.0
ROUND_MARGIN_S = 10.0
CAP_MARGIN_S = 60.0  # final: closed this long before the wave's cap at the latest
# R12.17: the model gets MODEL_WINDOW_S minus the time since the supplier's reply minus PER_OTHER_S for
# every other thread with a call in flight; under MIN_MODEL_S the planned move goes out without it.
MODEL_WINDOW_S, PER_OTHER_S, MIN_MODEL_S = 50.0, 15.0, 10.0


def model_budget(since_reply_s, others_in_flight):
    """Seconds the writer model may take, or None when the planned move must go without it."""
    budget = MODEL_WINDOW_S - max(0.0, since_reply_s) - PER_OTHER_S * max(0, others_in_flight)
    return budget if budget >= MIN_MODEL_S else None


class CaseClock:
    def __init__(self, seconds_left=None, now=time.monotonic):
        self.now = now
        self.t_open = None
        self.force_close_at, self.no_counter_at = FORCE_CLOSE_AT, NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT
        if isinstance(seconds_left, int | float) and seconds_left > 0:
            cap = seconds_left - CAP_MARGIN_S
            if cap < FORCE_CLOSE_AT:
                self.force_close_at = max(0.0, cap)
                self.no_counter_at = max(0.0, cap - (FORCE_CLOSE_AT - NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT))
        self.rounds = []  # measured round times, oldest first
        self._sent = {}  # sid -> when our last message went out
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def open(self):
        if self.t_open is None:
            self.t_open = self.now()
        return self

    def elapsed(self):
        return 0.0 if self.t_open is None else self.now() - self.t_open

    def sent(self, sid):
        with self._lock:
            self._sent[sid] = self.now()

    def replied(self, sid):
        """The supplier answered: one round measured (capped at MAX_ROUND_S)."""
        with self._lock:
            t = self._sent.pop(sid, None)
            if t is not None:
                self.rounds.append(min(self.now() - t, MAX_ROUND_S))

    def round_time(self):
        with self._lock:
            seen = self.rounds[-3:]
        return (max(seen) if seen else DEFAULT_ROUND_S) + ROUND_MARGIN_S

    def can_counter(self):
        """A new counter-offer may still go out: before NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT, and its round fits."""
        e = self.elapsed()
        return e < self.no_counter_at and e + self.round_time() <= self.force_close_at

    def round_fits(self):
        """One more round (e.g. a lock-in of a prose offer) finishes before FORCE_CLOSE_AT."""
        return self.elapsed() + self.round_time() <= self.force_close_at

    def late(self):
        return self.elapsed() >= self.no_counter_at

    def must_close(self):
        return self.elapsed() >= self.force_close_at

    def near_end(self, rounds=2):

          constraints, lever hints, relationship style, withdraw language. Every figure it returns
          must appear in the e-mail, or it is dropped (R11.2) - the model reads, it never sets a number.

def weighted_impact(drivers):
    """The price effect of the drivers the supplier named, in %: sum of change x cost share (R11.4)."""
    parts = [d["change_pct"] * d["share_pct"] / 100 for d in drivers if d.get("share_pct") is not None]
    return round(sum(parts), 2) if parts else None


def unchanged(mails):
    """How many replies in a row left the standing offer where it was."""
    n = 0
    for a, b in zip(reversed(mails[:-1]), reversed(mails[1:]), strict=True):
        x, y = (a.c, b.c) if a.c and b.c else (a.price, b.price)
        if x is None or y is None or abs(x - y) > STALE_TOL * x:
            break
        n += 1
    return n


def _boss(role):
    return bool(role) and any(w in role.lower() for w in BOSS_ROLES)


def walk_risk(mails):
    """(0..1, {signal: points}) over the whole thread, oldest mail first (R11.5)."""
    if not mails:
        return 0.0, {}
    last, prev = mails[-1], mails[:-1]
    if last.status == "walked_away":
        return 1.0, {"walked_away": 1.0}
    sig = {}
    if last.status == "final_offer":
        sig["final_offer"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["final_offer"]
    if (n := unchanged(mails)) >= 2:
        sig["price_unchanged_2_rounds"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["price_unchanged_2_rounds"]
    elif n == 1:
        sig["price_unchanged_1_round"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["price_unchanged_1_round"]
    delays = [m.delay for m in prev if m.delay is not None]
    if last.delay is not None and delays and last.delay > min(delays):
        sig["reply_delay_rising"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["reply_delay_rising"]
    valid = [m.validity for m in prev if m.validity is not None]
    if last.validity is not None and valid and last.validity < max(valid):
        sig["validity_shrinking"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["validity_shrinking"]
    if _boss(last.role) and any(m.role and not _boss(m.role) for m in prev):
        sig["escalated_to_boss"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["escalated_to_boss"]
    tones = [m.tone for m in prev if m.tone is not None]
    if last.tone is not None and tones and tones[-1] - last.tone >= 2:
        sig["tone_drop"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["tone_drop"]
    if last.withdraw:
        sig["withdraw_language"] = WALK_WEIGHTS["withdraw_language"]
    return round(min(1.0, sum(sig.values())), 2), sig


def tone_by_code(body):
    pos, neg = len(POSITIVE.findall(body or "")), len(NEGATIVE.findall(body or ""))
    return max(-2.0, min(2.0, round((pos - 2 * neg) / 2)))


def appears(value, text):
    """R11.2: a figure the model returned is real only if the e-mail has it."""
    if value is None:
        return False
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    forms = {f"{v:.2f}", f"{v:.1f}", f"{v:g}", f"{v:.2f}".replace(".", ","), f"{v:.1f}".replace(".", ",")}
    if v == int(v):
        forms.add(str(int(v)))
    return any(re.search(rf"(?<![\d.,]){re.escape(f)}(?![\d])", text or "") for f in forms)


def drivers_by_code(body, series_ids=()):
    out = []
    for s in prose.sentences(re.sub(r"\s*\n\s*", " ", body or "")):
        verb, share = DRIVER_VERB.search(s), SHARE.search(s)
        if not verb:
            continue
        chg = prose.number(verb.group("chg").lstrip("+"))
        if verb.group("verb").lower() in ("fell", "dropped", "decreased", "went down", "declined"):
            chg = -abs(chg)
        name = verb.group("name").split()[-1]
        series = next((i for i in series_ids if i.lower() == name.lower()), None)
        out.append({"name": name, "series": series, "change_pct": chg,
                    "share_pct": prose.number(share.group("share")) if share else None,
                    "quote": s.strip(), "source": "code"})  # fmt: skip
    return out


def clean_extraction(parsed, body, negotiable):
    """R11.2: keep only what the e-mail itself says - every figure must appear in it."""
    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
        return {}
    out = dict(parsed)
    offers = []
    for o in parsed.get("prose_offers") or []:
        if not isinstance(o, dict) or not appears(o.get("unit_price"), body):
            continue
        t = {"unit_price": float(o["unit_price"])}
        if o.get("payment_days") is not None and "payment_days" in negotiable and appears(o["payment_days"], body):
            t["payment_days"] = int(float(o["payment_days"]))
        if o.get("effective_date") and "effective_date" in negotiable:
            t["effective_date"] = str(o["effective_date"])[:10]
        for f, v in (o.get("other_terms") or {}).items():
            if f in negotiable and v is not None and (not isinstance(v, int | float) or appears(v, body)):
                t[f] = v
        offers.append({"terms": t, "quote": str(o.get("quote") or "")[:300], "source": "model"})
    out["prose_offers"] = offers
    drivers = []
    for d in parsed.get("cost_drivers") or []:
        if not isinstance(d, dict) or not appears(d.get("change_pct"), body):
            continue
        share = d.get("cost_share_pct")
        drivers.append({
            "name": str(d.get("name") or "?"), "change_pct": float(d["change_pct"]),
            "share_pct": float(share) if share is not None and appears(share, body) else None,
            "quote": str(d.get("quote") or "")[:300], "source": "model",
        })  # fmt: skip
    out["cost_drivers"] = drivers
    return out

def pick(intel, ctx):
    """(tactic name, reason). `intel`: the analyst's snapshot (or None); `ctx`: {first, rfq,
    rival_cheaper, cash_short, gap_pct, cost_gap_pct, data_claims, relationship, asked_for_terms, hold,
    supplier_held}."""
    scores, why = {n: 0.0 for n in TACTICS}, {n: [] for n in TACTICS}

    def add(name, points, reason):
        scores[name] += points
        why[name].append(reason)

    i = intel
    risk = i.walk_risk if i else 0.0
    gap = ctx.get("gap_pct")
    if ctx.get("first"):
        add("measured_lowball", 2.0, "first reply: we anchor")
    if (cg := ctx.get("cost_gap_pct")) is not None and cg > 1.0:
        add("data_argument", 2.5 if ctx.get("first") else 1.0, f"their own drivers explain {cg:.1f} points less")
    if ctx.get("data_claims"):
        add("data_argument", 1.0, f"{ctx['data_claims']} unused data argument(s)")
    if ctx.get("rfq") or ctx.get("rival_cheaper"):
        add("competitive_pressure", 2.0 if ctx.get("rival_cheaper") else 1.0, "a cheaper rival offer is real")
    if ctx.get("cash_short"):
        add("lever_trade", 1.5, "the supplier is short of cash")
    if ctx.get("asked_for_terms") or (i and i.lever_hints):
        add("lever_trade", 1.5, "they named a term they care about")
    if ctx.get("supplier_held") and ctx.get("hold") and not ctx.get("first"):
        add("firm_disappointment", 2.0, "their price did not move and we hold")
    if gap is not None and gap < 1.5 and not ctx.get("first"):
        add("appreciation_close", 2.5, f"gap only {gap:.1f}%")
    if risk >= 0.4:
        add("appreciation_close", 2.0, f"walk risk {risk:.2f}")
        scores["competitive_pressure"] -= 1.0
    if ctx.get("relationship") or (i and i.relationship_style == "relationship"):
        add("humor_rapport", 1.0, "relationship-driven supplier")
        if i and (i.tone or 0) >= 1 and not (i.unchanged_rounds >= 1):
            add("humor_rapport", 1.0, "friendly tone")
    if i and i.tone is not None and i.tone <= -1:
        scores["humor_rapport"] = -9.0  # never with an annoyed supplier
    if not (ctx.get("rfq") or ctx.get("rival_cheaper")):
        scores["competitive_pressure"] = -9.0  # never an invented rival
    # R11.13: firm disappointment only after a real hold by the supplier, never at walk risk >= 0.4,
    # and never on a message that makes a step
    if not (ctx.get("supplier_held") and ctx.get("hold")) or risk >= 0.4:
        scores["firm_disappointment"] = -9.0
    name = max(TACTICS, key=lambda n: (scores[n], -list(TACTICS).index(n)))
    if scores[name] <= 0:
        return ("measured_lowball" if ctx.get("first") else "lever_trade"), "default"
    return name, "; ".join(why[name])

def retryable(e):
    if isinstance(e, httpx.TransportError):

        return e.status >= 500 or (e.status == 429 and "practice" not in detail and "open sessions" not in detail)

def call(fn, *args):

        try:

        except Exception as e:
            if pause is None or not retryable(e):
                raise
            log.warning("retry %d after %s", i + 1, e)

"""R11.14–R11.15, R12.17 and R13.16: virtual time, no real sleeps."""

from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from arena_kit.spec import runner
from arena_kit.spec.clock import CaseClock, model_budget


class Time:
    def __init__(self, value=0.0):
        self.value = value

    def monotonic(self):
        return self.value

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        self.value += seconds


def test_r11_14_no_counter_at_360_and_force_close_at_420():
    time = Time(100)
    clock = CaseClock(now=time.monotonic).open()
    time.value = 459
    assert clock.can_counter()
    time.value = 460
    assert clock.late() and not clock.can_counter() and clock.round_fits()
    time.value = 520
    assert clock.must_close() and not clock.round_fits()
    clock.open()  # opening twice must not reset the case clock
    assert clock.elapsed() == 420


def test_r11_15_rounds_use_last_three_capped_at_90_plus_margin():
    time = Time()
    clock = CaseClock(now=time.monotonic).open()
    assert clock.round_time() == 55
    for seconds in (120, 10, 20, 30):
        clock.sent("supplier")
        time.sleep(seconds)
        clock.replied("supplier")
    assert clock.rounds == [90, 10, 20, 30]
    assert clock.round_time() == 40
    time.value = 350
    clock.rounds = [90]
    assert not clock.can_counter()  # round would end at 450, despite being before 360
    assert not clock.round_fits()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("seconds_left,no_counter,force", [(480, 360, 420), (240, 120, 180), (30, 0, 0)])
def test_wave_clock_shortens_to_actual_remaining_time(seconds_left, no_counter, force):
    clock = CaseClock(seconds_left)
    assert (clock.no_counter_at, clock.force_close_at) == (no_counter, force)

def test_r13_16_slow_post_recovers_already_visible_reply(monkeypatch):
    from concurrent.futures import TimeoutError
    from importlib import import_module

    play = import_module("arena_kit.play")
    reply = {"from": "supplier", "status": "final_offer"}

    class Pending:
        def result(self, timeout):
            assert timeout <= 3  # polling must leave almost the entire 60-second reply budget
            raise TimeoutError

        def done(self):
            return False

    monkeypatch.setattr(play, "SENDER", SimpleNamespace(submit=lambda *args: Pending()))
    client = SimpleNamespace(send_message=lambda *args: None)
    table = play.RemoteTable(client)
    reads = iter([[{"from": "supplier"}], [{"from": "supplier"}, {"from": "buyer"}, reply]])
    monkeypatch.setattr(table, "refresh", lambda sid: next(reads))
    assert table.send("supplier", {"body": "offer"}) is reply

"""One engine, settings per category goal (R13.10), with the anchor table of R4.1 merged in.

The merged anchor table (R13.10 asks for one). Two sources disagreed on the opening cut:
  R4.1 (BuyerAgent, data-driven)   leverage 12 %, routine 8 %, quality_first 6 %, stabilise 6 %,
                                   secure_supply 5 % off the best quote
  R13.10 (MESO, fixed shares)      leverage 0.85, routine 0.90, quality_first 0.92, stabilise the
                                   margin-optimal price, secure_supply 0.95 of the opening
Choice: the cut is the DEEPER of the two (leverage 15 %, routine 10 %, quality_first 8 %, stabilise
6 %, secure_supply 5 %). Both held up in their best runs (MESO's 0.85 for P18's 0.453, TeamAgent's
14 % + 4 for P05's 0.781), and the anchor never stands alone: R4.1 still takes the lowest of this
cut, the current price (price increases) and the fair price, and R4.2 then lifts it to the
credibility limits - at most 25 % under the supplier's price, never under its full cost x 1.01,
never under the price at which C stops falling. That last limit IS MESO's "margin-optimal price" for
stabilise (and secure_supply), so MESO's stabilise anchor is kept as a floor rather than a cut.
An RFQ adds RFQ_EXTRA (R12.6). The anchor is set once per thread (R4.4); in an RFQ it may only fall.

`horizon` is section 5's H per goal, tuned from MESO's `concede` column (R13.10 "Not taken from"):
a faster MESO pace (secure_supply 0.70) gets a shorter horizon; the others keep H = 6.
"""

# Levers to try first when the profile names none (R1.5).
TYPE_LEVERS = {
    "price_increase": ["effective_date", "payment_days"],
    "raw_material": ["index_clause", "payment_days", "contract_months"],
    "renewal": ["contract_months", "volume_per_year", "payment_days"],
    "bundling": ["contract_months", "payment_days"],
    "capacity": ["volume_per_year", "lead_time_days", "contract_months"],
    "quality": ["chargeback_eur_per_complaint", "ppm_commitment"],
    "rfq": ["payment_days", "lead_time_days", "tooling_eur"],
}
RFQ_EXTRA = 0.04  # R12.6: competition, open lower
MAX_ANCHOR_CUT = 0.25  # R4.2: never more than 25 % under the supplier's price
RFQ_HORIZON = 5  # R5.1: H = 5 in an RFQ

#   cut         share off the best quote (merged table above)
#   fair        margin on the price for the fair price (None: the case's sustainable margin)
#   horizon     section 5's H
#   first       terms settled first (R13.1), the rest by EUR weight
#   index       index clauses we offer: any, deadband (>= 3 % only), avoid
#   margin      C carries the supplier's margin charge (R2.3; the arena's rule for these goals)
#   walk        False: take the best sheet that beats the alternative rather than walk (R13.10)
#   close_gap   R13.13: accept once only price is left and the supplier is this close to our target
#   tone        for the writer
PLAYBOOK = {
    "leverage": {
        "cut": 0.15, "fair": 0.05, "horizon": 6, "first": ["payment_days", "index_clause"], "index": "any",
        "margin": False, "walk": True, "close_gap": 0.005,
        "tone": "A competitive category: argue firmly on price with market data; we have options.",
    },
    "routine": {
        "cut": 0.10, "fair": 0.06, "horizon": 6, "first": ["contract_months", "payment_days"], "index": "avoid",
        "margin": False, "walk": True, "close_gap": 0.01,
        "tone": "A routine category: keep it short and simple; we value a lean multi-year deal.",
    },
    "stabilise": {
        "cut": 0.06, "fair": None, "horizon": 6,
        "first": ["volume_per_year", "contract_months", "payment_days"], "index": "deadband",
        "margin": True, "walk": False, "close_gap": 0.005,
        "tone": "A strategic supplier: acknowledge real cost pressure and aim for a fair, stable long-term deal;"
        " do not fight a justified increase, ask for transparency instead.",
    },
    "secure_supply": {
        "cut": 0.05, "fair": None, "horizon": 5,
        "first": ["volume_per_year", "lead_time_days", "contract_months"], "index": "avoid",
        "margin": True, "walk": False, "close_gap": 0.015,
        "tone": "A bottleneck part: securing the full volume and lead time matters most; be cooperative and a"
        " reliable partner.",
    },
    "quality_first": {
        "cut": 0.08, "fair": 0.08, "horizon": 6, "first": ["ppm_commitment", "chargeback_eur_per_complaint"],
        "index": "avoid", "margin": False, "walk": True, "close_gap": 0.005,
        "tone": "A quality escalation: a binding defect commitment and chargebacks come before price; refer to the"
        " quality record.",
    },
}  # fmt: skip
DEFAULT_GOAL = "routine"  # section 0.5: an unknown goal plays the routine row

GOAL_WORDS = {
    "stabilise": "a strategic supplier: we want a healthy, reliable partner and stable prices, not the last cent",
    "secure_supply": "a bottleneck part: security of supply matters most; a supplier that is squeezed is a risk",
    "quality_first": "quality first: defects and late deliveries cost us more than a little price",
    "leverage": "leverage: competition and data should bring the price down",
    "routine": "a routine part: a fair market price with little effort",
}


def row(case):
    """The playbook row for the case's goal (routine when the goal is unknown)."""
    return PLAYBOOK.get((case.get("buyer") or {}).get("category_goal"), PLAYBOOK[DEFAULT_GOAL])


def type_levers(case):
    """The case type's levers; for an unknown type, the negotiable fields themselves (section 0.5)."""
    if case.get("type") in TYPE_LEVERS:
        return [f for f in TYPE_LEVERS[case["type"]] if f in case.get("negotiable", [])]
    return [f for f in case.get("negotiable", []) if f != "unit_price"]


def horizon(case):
    return RFQ_HORIZON if len(case.get("suppliers") or []) > 1 else row(case)["horizon"]


def anchor_cut(case):
    """The share off the best quote: the merged table, plus RFQ_EXTRA in an RFQ (R12.6)."""
    return row(case)["cut"] + (RFQ_EXTRA if len(case.get("suppliers") or []) > 1 else 0.0)
"""Concessions: reciprocal, never stuck (section 5), with TeamAgent's step size (R12.5).

Everything is in C. Per thread a `Plan` keeps the anchor (fixed, R4.4; in an RFQ it may only fall,
R12.6), the target of every offer we made and the supplier's C after every reply (one entry per
reply, so a hold shows as a zero step).

  curve        our k-th offer closes 1 - (1 - k/H)^1.6 of the gap from the anchor to their C (R5.1)
  reciprocity  they moved more than MOVE_TOL of C: our step = max(min(planned, 0.5 x theirs), MIN_STEP
               of C) (R5.2); "planned" is at least BREAK_SHARE of the gap left (R12.5)
  deadlock     they did not move: hold ONCE, then one real step - at least BREAK_SHARE of the gap
               left and MIN_STEP of C (R5.3). Never two holds in a row, never a token step
  still moving their offer meets our target but they conceded more than MIN_STEP of C last round
               with more than 3 rounds left: target = their C - 0.5 x their step (R5.4)
  caps         never above CEILING x their C (R12.5), never above 0.995 x the alternative's C; in an
               RFQ at most 0.99 x the best rival's C and never below the anchor (R5.5)
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

MOVE_TOL = 0.001  # R5.2: a move under 0.1 % of C is no move
MIN_STEP = 0.004  # R5.2/R5.3: our smallest visible step, 0.4 % of C
RECIPROCITY = 0.5  # R5.2: we move by at most half of what they moved
BREAK_SHARE = 0.15  # R5.3/R12.5: a real step is at least 15 % of the gap left
CEILING = 0.997  # R12.5: never above 0.997 x their C
ALT_CAP = 0.995  # R5.5
RIVAL_CAP = 0.99  # R5.5


def curve(k, horizon):
    """Share of the gap conceded by our k-th offer (k = 0: the anchor)."""
    return 1 - (1 - min(k, horizon) / horizon) ** 1.6


@dataclass
class Plan:
    anchor: float | None = None  # in C
    targets: list = field(default_factory=list)  # the target C of every offer we made
    their_costs: list = field(default_factory=list)  # the supplier's C after every reply
    replies: int = 0
    holds: int = 0  # our holds in a row

    def observe(self, c_theirs, replies):

            self.replies = replies

        elif rfq:

        return self.anchor

    def their_step(self):
        """How far the supplier came toward us in its last reply, in C (0 for a hold)."""
        if len(self.their_costs) < 2:
            return 0.0

            target = prev + ours
            info["ours"] = ours

            # behind our own last offer reads as a retreat (judgement call, DESIGN_NOTES)
            target = max(c_theirs - 0.5 * step, self.targets[-1] if self.targets else -math.inf)
